Class Product

java.lang.Object
com.konbini.model.Product
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Product extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a product in the store inventory with details, pricing, and inventory management. Tracks product information, stock levels, expiration dates, and low stock alerts. Implements Serializable to support persistence.

  • Constructor Details

    • Product

      public Product(String name, double price, int quantity, String category, String brand, String variant, LocalDate expirationDate)
      Constructs a new Product with the specified details. Automatically generates a unique ID for the product.
      Parameters:
      name - the product name (cannot be null or empty)
      price - the product price (must be greater than 0)
      quantity - the initial stock quantity (cannot be negative)
      category - the product category (cannot be null or empty)
      brand - the product brand (can be null or empty)
      variant - the product variant/subcategory (can be null or empty)
      expirationDate - the product expiration date (can be null for non-perishable items)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any required parameter is invalid

      public boolean isExpired()
      Checks if the product has expired. Non-perishable products (null expiration date) never expire.
